title: Claims
goal: A practitioner can read the claims artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: The named scenario is visibly identified and its primary subject is clearly shown.
The picture visibly uses the required standard diagram structure and connected elements.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the picture: Image 2 clearly depicts the claims scenario using a complete, connected event-driven process chain, whereas Image 1 substitutes a generic request/service workflow and omits registration and the shared closure sequence.
